mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (measured by the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by more than 0.25 percentage points over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, prompting risk-off sentiment that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production growth (measured by the 3-month change in INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods classified as late-cycle expansion with a decline in INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 jobs over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where PAYEMS has increased by more than 100,000 jobs over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, an acceleration in real GDP growth (measured by the quarterly change in GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods classified as early-cycle expansion with accelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where both INDPRO and GDPC1 are above their 3-month moving averages.
